quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova expands wind footprint in India with 163.4 MW (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova signed an agreement with Enfinity Global to supply and install 43 of its 3.8 MW-154m onshore wind turbines (163.4 MW) for the Fatehgarh Wind Farm in Rajasthan, India; deliveries are expected to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026. The turbines will be made at GE Vernova's Pune facility, which has annual capacity of up to 1,500 MW; GE Vernova has 5 GW of installed capacity in India.
quarterly_data.figure: 43 turbines of 3.8 MW, 163.4 MW; deliveries from fourth quarter of 2026; Pune capacity up to 1,500 MW
